verdict.rationale: Replicate is a model-hosting and inference API. Such a platform could plausibly accept MCP servers as tool sources for model runs, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack covers only running, fine-tuning, deploying and pricing models, and never mentions connecting or consuming MCP servers or their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
